script_text: Cancer, this week the Moon — your ruling planet — clashes with Pluto, shaking your foundations. Monday through Wednesday, the Moon squares Saturn in your 10th House, pressuring your career and public standing. Tuesday faces the hardest transit, avoid major decisions. Wednesday afternoon, Venus enters your 5th House of love, forming a trine with Jupiter that opens unexpected romantic connection. Thursday through Sunday, Mars aligns with Neptune in your 12th House, bringing intuitive gains but financial confusion — especially with money matters. The weekend offers emotional healing. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House and trines Jupiter in your 1st House, boosting love luck. Tuesday is your worst day because the Moon squares Saturn in your 10th House, creating career obstacles. Use Thursday's intuitive energy to review finances before committing. Follow for daily updates.
